reason: The only proposal (D-3a63a0) concerns backend not importing meresei/backend; nothing about test location or setupDom import. All tests are in tests/ and the Quill test imports ./setupDom.js before Quill.
D-3a63a0 restricts imports from meresei/backend, not the #~/ alias. Backend has ~155 #~/ imports; the remaining ../ imports target root services/ outside backend or are same-dir ./ imports.
No proposal on controller naming. Every directory in backend/api is named <Entity>Api.
No proposal on response methods. Most handlers use response.success/error/validation, but FileApi, PdfFileApi and CourseApi/getPublic use raw response.status().json().
D-3a63a0 is backend-only. Frontend has ~420 ~/ imports, plus a handful of ../ sibling imports (e.g. OldProblem, TypesOfTasks).
No file-layout proposal for pages. Every routed page component in router.js is imported from frontend/pages/<route>.
No proposal on component placement. Shared components live in components/ and appComponents/; page-specific ones sit under pages/*/components.
No proposal on the appComponents/components split. Mostly generic in components/, but app-specific components such as CourseActions and CourseCreationModal sit in components/.
No layering proposal for frontend API calls. Components call api.get/post.XApi; one direct fetch appears in pages/admin_notifications (others are in services/).
No styling proposal. 67 JS files import a co-located css module; many small components have no stylesheet or reuse another's (SequenceAudioButton).
No SCSS proposal. 53 of 64 component stylesheets have exactly one :local(); 11 have 2-4 (e.g. courses_id has .edit and .view).
No SCSS proposal. Sampled stylesheets nest children inside the :local() wrapper.
No className proposal. ~1058 string classNames vs 80 css.x uses; a few files use css.x on several elements.
No database proposal. All backend/api DB imports are #~/db/knex.js; no pg-promise remains in the code or package.json.
No proposal on class components. Class components are plentiful, but whether any were converted cannot be checked from a single-commit checkout.
No export-style proposal. Only backend/services/auth.js uses export const (8 times) among ~350 JS files.
No formatting proposal. Aligned imports, object values and JSX props are common (~130 aligned object-value lines); many short objects are unaligned.
No comment proposal. About 159 JS files contain consecutive // comment lines, including hard-wrapped prose comments in knex.js and Loading.
No comment proposal. 219 [claude comment] single-line comments; a few sit in multi-line comment blocks (registerBlots). Authorship of unprefixed comments cannot be determined.
No control-flow proposal. if/else-return (~52 sites) and early-return-then-return (~46 one-line plus many block forms) are about equally common.
No fallback-style proposal. `|| literal` fallbacks (~101) far outnumber `x ? x :` ternaries (~10).
No naming proposal for pages. Most pages are Page_<segments>; several (admin_*, courses_id_learn, offline_courses) use a bare `Page` class name, none camelCase.
No SQL-quoting proposal. No pg-promise queries remain in backend, so the scope has no code.
No member-order proposal. Sampled classes go static, state, lifecycle, other methods, render last.
D-3a63a0 is about meresei imports, not module syntax. Backend uses ESM everywhere; the only require() is commented out.
No routing proposal. Endpoints go through /api/:controllerName.:methodName; auth, files and pdfs remain REST with stated reasons.
No database proposal. DB code imports knex from #~/db/knex.js (60 files).
No pg-promise proposal. pg-promise is absent from backend code and dependencies.
No case-convention proposal. Results and most inserts use camelCase, but many query clauses reference snake_case columns directly (e.g. where('user_id')).
No SPE proposal. Most API calls pass (spe) => setState({ speX }); some initialize speX to { status: 'success' } and some pass false/null dispatch.
No Loading proposal. <Loading spe> is used in 33 files; some components check spe.status directly instead.
No form proposal. Forms keep formState and spread inputProps(); AuthModal uses signupFormState/signinFormState variants.
No submit proposal. AuthModal follows it fully; CourseCreationModal disables the button and shows failures but has no early return; contact uses plain <Loading>.
No PageApi proposal. Per-page GET routes are in PageApi; some page data (AdminApi.getStats, CourseApi.getPublic) is served from other controllers.
No PageApi proposal. All PageApi methods are get*; no insert/update/delete inside.
No globals proposal. No assignment to React/PropTypes/connect/Quill/process/require found; some files import them explicitly instead, which is not reassignment.
No unused-vars proposal. Checking needs ESLint, which would mean running repository tooling.
No proposal. The item is a lint-rule setting (jsx-uses-react), and nothing in the code can be checked against it without running ESLint.
No proposal. The item is a lint-rule setting (jsx-uses-vars), and nothing in the code can be checked against it without running ESLint.
No key-prop proposal. Sampled .map() JSX roots carry key; unkeyed hits are inner children of keyed rows.
No deprecated-API proposal. No componentWillMount/WillReceiveProps/WillUpdate, findDOMNode or ReactDOM.render found.
No state-mutation proposal. No direct this.state.x = assignments found.
No children-prop proposal. No children={...} JSX props found.
D-3a63a0 is an import restriction, not unused-variable detection. Checking needs ESLint, which would mean running repository tooling.
